---
title: Honest limits
description: What this build doesn't do yet, said plainly, and what comes next.
icon: TriangleExclamationPoint
---

- **Live isn't built yet.** Everything runs on NEAR testnet with test USDC. Live needs Tegata's `tegata.near`
  operator and the mainnet side of the app.
- **Paying from another chain stops at the quote.** NEAR Intents has no testnet, so the deposit address that turns a
  payer's coin into USDC on NEAR is part of Live and isn't built yet. Today customers pay in USDC on NEAR.
- **Emails are switched off on the live site** until a sending domain is set up, so invoice and reminder emails
  don't go out. Sending an invoice still gives you its link to share.
- **Payroll pays Tegata and NEAR accounts.** Another chain is Live-only, and a bank account is shown locked: cash-out
  to a bank needs a licensed payout partner. Payroll emails wait for email too; until then you share each person's
  link.
- **Not in this build yet:** CSV export and the monthly statement, refunds, and signing in with a NEAR wallet.
- **The autopilot contract has no upgrade method, but its account does.** `pay.tegata.testnet`'s only key is the
  operator's, so during the hackathon Tegata can redeploy it. Autopilot pays Tegata and NEAR accounts only.
- **The Sandbox stash is shared.** Add test dollars draws from Tegata's own test USDC and can run dry; Circle's faucet
  is the fallback.
- **Referrals don't yet flag two accounts opened from one device or network.**
- **No outside businesses have used it yet.**

## Next

These are planned, in this order, and none of them is described anywhere in these docs as working:

| Next | What it adds |
| --- | --- |
| Books | Activity with filters, CSV export, the monthly statement, refunds |
| Developers | API keys, checkout sessions, signed webhooks, a counter mode |
| Live | Real dollars on mainnet, and paying in from other chains through NEAR Intents |
